m316-043-0427.summary: Krasin reports that the Berlin trade representation now works well, that the auditing commission has found damaging material on its previous period, asks for Kulyabko to be sent to Berlin and for no decisions to be taken before the commission reports.

m316-043-0432.summary: Lutovinov protests against Kopp being kept in Berlin as polpred before the audit ends, asks to whom he should hand over his duties and says he will hand over to Brodovsky within hours.

system: Each Russian letter becomes a digit pair from a 5 x 6 table (first digit 6-9 or 0, second 0-5), the pairs are written row by row into an N x N digit square (N spelled out before the groups) and sent column by column.
